title: The residual stream and the logit lens
summary: A shared workspace every layer adds to, and when the prediction forms.

steps.text: Every sublayer **reads** the residual stream and **adds** to it; nothing overwrites it. This view follows one position's vector through every snapshot.
steps.prompt: Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She

steps.text: Switch to what each sublayer writes: the rows sum to the final vector. The write-size bars show which sublayers made big changes at this position.
The **logit lens** decodes every snapshot as if it were the last, using the final layer norm and unembedding. Each row is what the stream “would say” so far.
Reading down a column shows the guess forming: often wrong early, right late. The right-hand column gives each row's accuracy.

ask.question: Click a cell in a column where an **early** row is already correct (underlined).
ask.correct: Some predictions are easy enough to be readable from the embeddings; others only form in the last layers.
